from studio.common.base import Main

from studio.base.data.utils import IMG_FILE_TYPES, TEXT_FILE_TYPES
from studio.utils.file_types import ATTACHMENT_ONLY_FILE_TYPES
from studio.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from studio.inputs import BoolInput
from studio.io import (
    DropdownInput,
    FileInput,
    MessageTextInput,
    MultilineInput,
    Output,
)
from studio.schema.message import Message
from studio.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)

INCOMING_FILE_PATHS_KEY = "incoming_file_paths"


class ChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        MultilineInput(
            name="conversation_history",
            display_name="Conversation History",
            value="",
            info="History to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=True,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        FileInput(
            name="files",
            display_name="Files",
            file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES + ATTACHMENT_ONLY_FILE_TYPES,
            info="Files to be sent with the message. Supports: PDF, DOCX, Excel, PPTX, images, and text files.",
            advanced=True,
            is_list=True,
            temp_file=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="background_color",
            display_name="Background Color",
            info="The background color of the icon.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="chat_icon",
            display_name="Icon",
            info="The icon of the message.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="text_color",
            display_name="Text Color",
            info="The text color of the name",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
        Output(
            display_name="Conversation History",
            name="history",
            method="conversation_history_response",
        ),
    ]

    async def conversation_history_response(self) -> Message:
        background_color = self.background_color
        text_color = self.text_color
        icon = self.chat_icon

        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatInput.conversation_history_response] ENTRY | self.files=%s | file_count=%s",
            type(self.files).__name__,
            len(self.files) if self.files else 0,
        )

        if not self.files or len(self.files) == 0:
            message = Message(
                text=self.conversation_history,
                sender=self.sender,
                sender_name=self.sender_name,
                session_id=self.session_id,
                files=self.files,
                properties={
                    "background_color": background_color,
                    "text_color": text_color,
                    "icon": icon,
                },
            )
        else:
            message = await Message.create(
                text=self.conversation_history,
                sender=self.sender,
                sender_name=self.sender_name,
                session_id=self.session_id,
                files=self.files,
                properties={
                    "background_color": background_color,
                    "text_color": text_color,
                    "icon": icon,
                },
            )

        self.history.value = message
        self.status = message
        return message

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        background_color = self.background_color
        text_color = self.text_color
        icon = self.chat_icon

        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatInput.message_response] ENTRY | self.files=%s | file_count=%s | files_repr=%s",
            type(self.files).__name__,
            len(self.files) if self.files else 0,
            repr(self.files)[:200] if self.files else "None/empty",
        )

        if not self.files or len(self.files) == 0:
            message = Message(
                text=self.input_value,
                sender=self.sender,
                sender_name=self.sender_name,
                session_id=self.session_id,
                files=self.files,
                properties={
                    "background_color": background_color,
                    "text_color": text_color,
                    "icon": icon,
                },
            )
        else:
            message = await Message.create(
                text=self.input_value,
                sender=self.sender,
                sender_name=self.sender_name,
                session_id=self.session_id,
                files=self.files,
                properties={
                    "background_color": background_color,
                    "text_color": text_color,
                    "icon": icon,
                },
            )

        if (
            self.files
            and hasattr(self, "graph")
            and self.graph
            and hasattr(self.graph, "context")
        ):
            paths = [f for f in self.files if isinstance(f, str)]
            if paths:
                existing = self.graph.context.get(INCOMING_FILE_PATHS_KEY, [])
                self.graph.context[INCOMING_FILE_PATHS_KEY] = existing + paths
                Main.logger().debug(
                    "[ChatInput] Stored %s incoming file path(s) in graph.context | paths=%s",
                    len(paths),
                    paths,
                )
            else:
                Main.logger().debug(
                    "[ChatInput] self.files present but no str paths | types=%s",
                    [type(f).__name__ for f in self.files],
                )
        else:
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatInput] No files to store | self.files=%s | has_graph=%s",
                bool(self.files),
                hasattr(self, "graph") and self.graph is not None,
            )

        if (
            self.session_id
            and isinstance(message, Message)
            and self.should_store_message
        ):
            stored_message = await self.send_message(
                message,
            )
            self.message.value = stored_message
            message = stored_message

        self.status = message
        return message

from studio.base.prompts.api_utils import process_prompt_template
from studio.custom import Component
from studio.inputs.inputs import DefaultPromptField
from studio.io import MessageTextInput, Output, PromptInput
from studio.schema.message import Message
from studio.template.utils import update_template_values
from studio.common.benchmarking_utilities import time_it

class PromptComponent(Component):
    display_name: str = "Prompt"
    description: str = "Create a prompt template with dynamic variables."
    icon = "prompts"
    trace_type = "prompt"
    name = "Prompt"

    inputs = [
        PromptInput(name="template", display_name="Template"),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="tool_placeholder",
            display_name="Tool Placeholder",
            tool_mode=True,
            advanced=True,
            info="A placeholder input for tool mode.",
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Prompt Message", name="prompt", method="build_prompt"),
    ]

    @time_it
    async def build_prompt(self) -> Message:
        prompt = Message.from_template(**self._attributes)
        self.status = prompt.text
        return prompt

    def _update_template(self, frontend_node: dict):
        prompt_template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        custom_fields = frontend_node["custom_fields"]
        frontend_node_template = frontend_node["template"]
        _ = process_prompt_template(
            template=prompt_template,
            name="template",
            custom_fields=custom_fields,
            frontend_node_template=frontend_node_template,
        )
        return frontend_node

    async def update_frontend_node(self, new_frontend_node: dict, current_frontend_node: dict):
        """This function is called after the code validation is done."""
        frontend_node = await super().update_frontend_node(new_frontend_node, current_frontend_node)
        template = frontend_node["template"]["template"]["value"]
        # Kept it duplicated for backwards compatibility
        _ = process_prompt_template(
            template=template,
            name="template",
            custom_fields=frontend_node["custom_fields"],
            frontend_node_template=frontend_node["template"],
        )
        # Now that template is updated, we need to grab any values that were set in the current_frontend_node
        # and update the frontend_node with those values
        update_template_values(new_template=frontend_node, previous_template=current_frontend_node["template"])
        return frontend_node

    def _get_fallback_input(self, **kwargs):
        return DefaultPromptField(**kwargs)

    def _gateway_base_url(self) -> str:
        """Return the full gateway base URL including API prefix."""

            (get_config().channel_gateway_api_url or "")
            + ChatOutput.CHANNEL_GATEWAY_REST_API_PREFIX
        )

    def _get_agent_id(self) -> str:
        """Resolve agent_id from graph flow_id."""
        try:
            flow_id = self.graph.flow_id
        except AttributeError as exc:
            raise ValueError("graph flow_id not found") from exc
        return str(flow_id)

    def _get_agent_session_id(self) -> str:
        """Resolve agent_session_id from graph context."""
        try:
            session_id = self.graph.context["agent_session_id"]
        except (AttributeError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise KeyError("agent_session_id not found in graph context") from exc
        return str(session_id)

    def _set_llm_fields_visibility(self, build_config: dotdict, visible: bool) -> None:
        """Show or hide shared LLM inputs when channel delivery is toggled."""
        for name in ChatOutput._LLM_FIELD_NAMES:
            if name in build_config:
                build_config[name]["show"] = visible

    async def _auto_populate_routes(self, build_config: dotdict) -> None:
        """Fetch all routes for this agent and auto-populate selected_routes and delivery_targets schema."""
        agent_id = self._get_agent_id()
        if not agent_id:
            return
        try:
            routes = await self._fetch_and_filter_routes(build_config, agent_id)
        except Exception as exc:
            Main.logger().warning(
                f"[ChatOutput._auto_populate_routes] Failed | agent_id={agent_id} | error={exc}"
            )
            raise

    async def _fetch_and_filter_routes(
        self, build_config: dotdict, agent_id: str
    ) -> list[dict]:
        """Fetch routes, filter by access, and populate build config."""
        base_url = self._gateway_base_url()
        routes = await fetch_agent_routes(base_url, agent_id)
        raw_route_summary = [
            f"{r.get('channel_name', '?')}({r.get('channel_type', '?')}/{r.get('route_type', '?')})"
            for r in routes
        ]
        Main.logger().debug(
            f"[ChatOutput._auto_populate_routes] Raw routes | agent_id={agent_id} | {raw_route_summary}"
        )
        user_id = str(self._user_id) if self._user_id else None
        workspace_id = (
            build_config.get("workspace_id", {}).get("value", "") or self.workspace_id
        )
        if user_id and workspace_id:
            try:
                routes = await filter_routes_by_user_access(
                    routes=routes,
                    flow_id=agent_id,
                    user_id=user_id,
                    workspace_id=workspace_id,
                )
            except Exception as exc:
                Main.logger().warning(
                    f"[ChatOutput._auto_populate_routes] User access filter failed | error={exc}"
                )
                raise
        display_options = [
            f"{r['channel_name']} | {r['channel_type']} | {r['route_type']} | {r['route_id']}"
            f" | {r.get('description', '')} | {r.get('purpose', '')}"
            for r in routes
            if r.get("channel_type") not in ChatOutput.EXCLUDED_CHANNEL_TYPES
        ]
        build_config[ChatOutput.ATTR_SELECTED_ROUTES]["options"] = display_options
        build_config[ChatOutput.ATTR_SELECTED_ROUTES]["value"] = display_options
        await update_delivery_targets_schema(
            build_config=build_config,
            routes=routes,
            delivery_targets=self.delivery_targets or [],
            delivery_targets_key=ChatOutput.ATTR_DELIVERY_TARGETS,
            excluded_channel_types=ChatOutput.EXCLUDED_CHANNEL_TYPES,
            gateway_base_url=base_url,
        )
        Main.logger().debug(
            f"[ChatOutput._auto_populate_routes] Done | agent_id={agent_id} | count={len(display_options)}"
        )
        return routes

    def _get_user_query(self) -> str:
        """Resolve the user query, preferring the inbound channel message.

        Falls back to the upstream ChatInput value from the graph (e.g.
        playground/no-channel runs) when no inbound original_message is
        present, so the delivery resolver still receives the user's intent
        instead of an empty query.
        """
        inbound_ctx = self._get_inbound_channel_context()
        original_message = str(inbound_ctx.get("original_message", "") or "")
        if original_message:
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._get_user_query] source=inbound | query=%s",
                original_message[:120],
            )
            return original_message
        fallback = self._chat_input_value()
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._get_user_query] source=chat_input | query=%s",
            fallback[:120],
        )
        return fallback

    def _get_inbound_channel_context(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Return the inbound channel context dict, or empty when absent."""
        try:
            graph_ctx = self.graph.context
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            return {}
        return graph_ctx.get("inbound_channel_context", {}) or {}

    def _chat_input_value(self) -> str:
        """Read the user input from the upstream ChatInput vertex params."""
        try:
            vertices = self.graph.vertices
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._chat_input_value] graph.vertices unavailable"
            )
            return ""
        for vertex in vertices:
            if ChatOutput._CHAT_INPUT_COMPONENT_NAME not in vertex.id:
                continue
            value = vertex.params.get("input_value", "")
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._chat_input_value] vertex=%s | input_value=%s",
                vertex.id,
                str(value)[:120],
            )
            if value:
                return str(value)
        return ""

    @staticmethod
    def _derive_routes_from_targets(delivery_targets: list[dict]) -> list[str]:
        """Build selected_routes from delivery_targets rows at runtime."""
        seen: set[str] = set()
        routes: list[str] = []
        for row in delivery_targets:
            channel_str = row.get("channel", "").strip()
            if channel_str and channel_str not in seen:
                seen.add(channel_str)
                routes.append(channel_str)
        return routes

    def _input_to_text(self) -> str:
        """Convert the HandleInput input_value to a plain string."""
        value = self.input_value
        if value is None:
            return ""
        try:
            return value.get_text() or ""
        except AttributeError:
            return str(value)

    async def _store_chat_message(self, text: str) -> Message:
        """Build and optionally persist the chat message for display."""
        source, icon, display_name, source_id = (
            self.get_properties_from_source_component()
        )
        if self.chat_icon:
            icon = self.chat_icon
        if type(self.input_value) is Message:
            message = self.input_value
            message.text = text
        else:
            message = Message(text=text)
        message.sender = self.sender
        message.sender_name = self.sender_name
        message.session_id = self.session_id
        message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id
        message.properties.source = Source(
            id=source_id or None, display_name=display_name or None
        )
        message.properties.icon = icon
        message.properties.background_color = self.background_color
        message.properties.text_color = self.text_color
        message.properties.state = "complete"
        message.properties.allow_markdown = False
        message.properties.edited = False
        if self.session_id and self.should_store_message:
            message = await self.send_message(message)
        self.status = message
        return message

    async def _run_channel_delivery(self, bot_text: str) -> None:
        """Delegate delivery to ProcessChannelDelivery with injected LLM config."""
        config = get_config()
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._run_channel_delivery] START | ff_file_url_strategy=%s | attach_incoming_files=%s",
            config.ff_file_url_strategy,
            self.attach_incoming_files,
        )
        message_refs = self._collect_message_file_refs()
        incoming_refs: list[dict] = []
        if self.attach_incoming_files:
            incoming_refs = self._collect_incoming_file_refs()
        deliverable_refs = self._collect_deliverable_file_refs()
        file_refs = message_refs + incoming_refs + deliverable_refs
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._run_channel_delivery] file_refs collected | message=%s | incoming=%s | deliverable=%s | total=%s",
            len(message_refs),
            len(incoming_refs),
            len(deliverable_refs),
            len(file_refs),
        )
        if file_refs:
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._run_channel_delivery] file_refs[0] keys=%s | sample=%s",
                list(file_refs[0].keys()),
                {k: str(v)[:80] for k, v in file_refs[0].items() if k != "content"},
            )

        llm, _display_name = await self.build_llm()
        resolver = DeliveryLLMResolver(llm)
        processor = ProcessChannelDelivery(resolver)
        gateway_base_url = self._gateway_base_url()
        gateway_client = GatewayClientAdapter(gateway_base_url)

        _raw = self.delivery_targets
        delivery_targets = (
            _raw.to_dict("records") if hasattr(_raw, "to_dict") else (_raw or [])
        )
        inbound_context = self._extract_inbound_context()
        request = DeliveryRequest(
            agent_session_id=self._get_agent_session_id(),
            bot_response=bot_text,
            delivery_targets=delivery_targets,
            file_attachments=file_refs,
            gateway_base_url=gateway_base_url,
            inbound_context=inbound_context,
            user_query=self._get_user_query(),
        )
        results = await processor.process(request, gateway_client)
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._run_channel_delivery] Done | results=%s | successes=%s",
            len(results),
            sum(1 for r in results if r.success),
        )

    def _extract_inbound_context(self) -> InboundChannelContext:
        """Extract inbound channel context from graph for LLM awareness."""
        try:
            graph_ctx = self.graph.context
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._extract_inbound_context] graph.context unavailable"
            )
            return InboundChannelContext()
        inbound_ctx = graph_ctx.get("inbound_channel_context", {}) or {}
        external_user = graph_ctx.get("external_user_name", "") or ""
        incoming_channel = graph_ctx.get("incoming_channel_type", "") or ""
        incoming_route = graph_ctx.get("incoming_route_type", "") or ""
        incoming_user_name = str(inbound_ctx.get("sender_name", "") or "") or str(
            external_user
        )
        channel_type = str(inbound_ctx.get("channel_type", "") or "") or str(
            incoming_channel
        )
        route_type = str(inbound_ctx.get("route_type", "") or "") or str(incoming_route)
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._extract_inbound_context] external_user_name=%s | incoming_channel=%s | inbound_ctx_keys=%s",
            external_user,
            incoming_channel,
            list(inbound_ctx.keys()) if inbound_ctx else "empty",
        )
        return InboundChannelContext(
            channel_type=channel_type,
            incoming_user_name=incoming_user_name,
            original_message=str(inbound_ctx.get("original_message", "") or "")[:500],
            route_type=route_type,
        )

    def _collect_message_file_refs(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Extract file references from the input Message, if present."""
        refs: list[dict] = []
        if type(self.input_value) is not Message:
            return refs
        if not self.input_value.files:
            return refs
        config = get_config()
        for f in self.input_value.files:
            if type(f) is not str:
                continue
            if config.ff_file_url_strategy == FileUrlStrategy.S3_KEY:
                original_name = extract_original_file_name(f)
                s3_ref = resolve_incoming_file_s3_reference(f)
                refs.append(
                    {
                        "file_name": original_name,
                        "file_path": f,
                        **s3_ref.model_dump(),
                    }
                )
            else:
                original_name = extract_original_file_name(f)
                url = resolve_incoming_file_url(f)
                refs.append(
                    {
                        "file_name": original_name,
                        "file_path": f,
                        "url": url,
                    }
                )
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._collect_message_file_refs] → %s file_ref(s) | raw_count=%s | strategy=%s",
            len(refs),
            len(self.input_value.files),
            config.ff_file_url_strategy,
        )
        return refs

    def _collect_incoming_file_refs(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Collect file refs from incoming channel files stored in graph context."""
        refs: list[dict] = []
        try:
            incoming = self.graph.context.get(INCOMING_FILE_PATHS_KEY, [])
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            return refs
        config = get_config()
        Main.logger().debug(
            "[ChatOutput._collect_incoming_file_refs] paths=%s | strategy=%s",
            len(incoming),
            config.ff_file_url_strategy,
        )
        for p in incoming:
            original_name = extract_original_file_name(p)
            if config.ff_file_url_strategy == FileUrlStrategy.S3_KEY:
                s3_ref = resolve_incoming_file_s3_reference(p)
                ref_dict = {
                    "file_name": original_name,
                    "file_path": p,
                    **s3_ref.model_dump(),
                }
                Main.logger().debug(
                    "[ChatOutput._collect_incoming_file_refs] S3_KEY | name=%s | s3_bucket=%s | s3_key=%s",
                    original_name,
                    s3_ref.s3_bucket,
                    s3_ref.s3_key[:60],
                )
                refs.append(ref_dict)
            else:
                url = resolve_incoming_file_url(p)
                refs.append(
                    {
                        "file_name": original_name,
                        "file_path": p,
                        "url": url,
                    }
                )
                Main.logger().debug(
                    "[ChatOutput._collect_incoming_file_refs] URL | name=%s | url=%s",
                    original_name,
                    url[:80] if url else "(empty)",
                )
        return refs

    def _collect_deliverable_file_refs(self) -> list[dict]:
        """Collect file deliverables from graph context."""
        try:
            deliverables = self.graph.context.get(FILE_DELIVERABLES_KEY, [])
        except (AttributeError, TypeError):
            return []
        if deliverables:
            Main.logger().debug(
                "[ChatOutput._collect_deliverable_file_refs] count=%s | keys=%s",
                len(deliverables),
                list(deliverables[0].keys()) if deliverables else [],
            )
        return deliverables

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        """Store and display the message, then deliver to channels if toggle is on."""
        bot_text = self._input_to_text()
        message = await self._store_chat_message(bot_text)
        if self.channel_delivery:
            await self._run_channel_delivery(bot_text)
        return message

    async def update_build_config(
        self,
        build_config: dotdict,
        field_value: Any,
        field_name: str | None = None,
    ) -> dotdict:
        """Toggle channel delivery fields; auto-fetch routes; handle model provider UI."""
        if field_name == ChatOutput.ATTR_CHANNEL_DELIVERY:
            is_on = bool(field_value)
            for field in ChatOutput._CHANNEL_DELIVERY_FIELDS:
                if field in build_config:
                    build_config[field]["show"] = is_on
            self._set_llm_fields_visibility(build_config, is_on)
            if is_on:
                provider_name = build_config.get(
                    "model_provider", {}
                ).get("value", "")
                if provider_name:
                    build_config = await self.update_llm_build_config(
                        build_config,
                        str(provider_name),
                        "model_provider",
                    )
                await self._auto_populate_routes(build_config)
            return build_config

        if field_name in (
            "model_provider",
            LLMBasedComponent.MODEL_ID_FIELD,
            "region_name",
        ):
            build_config = await self.update_llm_build_config(
                build_config, str(field_value), field_name
            )

        if field_name == ChatOutput.ATTR_DELIVERY_TARGETS:
            await self._auto_populate_routes(build_config)

        if field_name in ("assumed_policy_id", "workspace_id"):
            await self._refresh_policy_options(build_config)

        return build_config

    async def _refresh_policy_options(self, build_config: dotdict) -> None:
        """Fetch and update Assume Policy dropdown options from workspace policies."""
        if not self.workspace_id:
            return
        orm_manager = get_orm_manager()
        try:
            async with orm_manager.with_session() as session:
                policies = await orm_manager.get_policies_by_workspace_id(
                    session, self.workspace_id
                )
        except Exception as exc:
            Main.logger().error(f"Failed to fetch workspace policies: {exc!s}")
            raise
        options = [""]
        metadata = [{"label": "None (use flow settings)", "icon": "x"}]
        for p in policies:
            options.append(str(p.id))
            metadata.append({"label": p.name, "icon": "shield"})
        if "assumed_policy_id" in build_config:
            build_config["assumed_policy_id"]["options"] = options
            build_config["assumed_policy_id"]["options_metadata"] = metadata

    def _extract_key_value(self, key_name: str) -> Message:
        """Extracts a specific key value from structured data."""
        structured_data = getattr(self, "_last_structured_data", [])
        if not structured_data:
            return Message(
                text=f"No structured data available for key '{key_name}'",
            )
        key_values = [
            item.get(key_name)
            for item in structured_data
            if isinstance(item, dict) and key_name in item
        ]
        if not key_values:
            return Message(
                text=f"Field '{key_name}' not found in structured output",
                sender_name=self.display_name,
            )
        if len(key_values) == 1:
            return Message(
                text=str(key_values[0]),
                data={key_name: key_values[0]},
            )
        combined_text = ", ".join(
            str(value) for value in key_values if value is not None
        )
        return Message(
            text=combined_text,
            data={key_name: key_values},
        )

    async def _extract_structured_output(self, llm_model, source_text=None):
        """Extract structured output from LLM. Handles both direct input and agent response extraction.

        Supports two modes via the output_schema TableSchemaInput:
        1. Table mode: Uses output_schema as a list of field definitions
        2. Schema mode: Uses output_schema as a JSON Schema string to create nested Pydantic models
        """
        try:
            input_mode = self.output_schema_input_mode
        except AttributeError:
            input_mode = "table"

        if input_mode == "schema":
            if not self.output_schema or (
                isinstance(self.output_schema, str) and not self.output_schema.strip()
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "JSON schema is required when using schema mode in output_schema."
                )
            try:
                if isinstance(self.output_schema, str):
                    json_schema_data = json.loads(self.output_schema)
                else:
                    json_schema_data = self.output_schema
            except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
                raise ValueError(f"invalid JSON format in output schema: {e}") from e
            if not isinstance(json_schema_data, dict):
                raise ValueError(
                    "output schema must be a dictionary/object structure when using schema mode."
                )
            output_model = build_nested_model_from_json_schema(
                json_schema_data, model_name=self.schema_name
            )
            output_schema_model = create_model(
                self.schema_name,
                objects=(
                    list[output_model],
                    Field(description="List of output objects."),
                ),
            )
        else:
            if not self.output_schema:
                raise ValueError(
                    "output schema is required when structured output is enabled."
                )
            output_model = build_model_from_schema(self.output_schema)

            output_schema_model = create_model(
                self.schema_name,
                objects=(
                    list[output_model],
                    Field(description="List of output objects."),
                ),
            )

        supports_structured_output = (
            await check_model_supports_structured_output(self.model_id)
            if self.model_id
            else False
        )

        if not supports_structured_output:
            return await self._prompt_based_structured_output(
                llm_model, output_schema_model, source_text
            )

        structured_parser = llm_model.with_structured_output(output_schema_model)

        if source_text:
            system_prompt = f"{self.structured_output_prompt}\n\nExtract structured data from the following text:"
            input_text = source_text
        else:
            system_prompt = self.structured_output_prompt
            input_text = self.input_value.text

        messages = [
            SystemMessage(content=system_prompt),
            HumanMessage(content=input_text),
        ]
        result = None
        async for chunk in structured_parser.astream(messages):
            result = chunk

        structured_data = (
            result.model_dump().get(AgentComponent.OBJECTS_FIELD, []) if result else []
        )
        self._last_structured_data = structured_data

        return Message(
            text=json.dumps({"results": structured_data}, indent=2),
            sender_name=self.display_name,
            data={"structured_output": structured_data},
        )

    async def _prompt_based_structured_output(
        self, llm_model, output_schema_model, source_text=None
    ):
        """Generate structured output using enhanced prompting and parsing."""

        parser = PydanticOutputParser(pydantic_object=output_schema_model)
        format_instructions = parser.get_format_instructions()
        system_content = f"{self.structured_output_prompt}\n\n{format_instructions}"
        if source_text:
            system_content += "\n\nExtract structured data from the following text:"
            input_text = source_text
        else:
            input_text = self.input_value.text

        messages = [
            SystemMessage(content=system_content),
            HumanMessage(content=input_text),
        ]

        chunks = []
        async for chunk in llm_model.astream(messages):
            chunks.append(chunk)

        content = "".join([self._get_response_content(chunk) for chunk in chunks])

        result = parser.parse(content)
        structured_data = (
            [obj.model_dump() for obj in result.objects] if result.objects else []
        )
        self._last_structured_data = structured_data

        return Message(
            text=json.dumps({"results": structured_data}, indent=2),
            sender_name=self.display_name,
            data={"structured_output": structured_data},
        )

    def _get_response_content(self, response) -> str:
        """Extract text content from any LLM response format."""

        content = response.content

        if isinstance(content, str):
            return content
        if isinstance(content, list):
            return "".join(
                block.get("text", "")
                for block in content
                if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "text"
            )

        return str(content)

    def _get_effective_kb_name(self) -> str | None:
        """Read the compiled permission map to decide primary vs fallback KB."""
        kb_name = getattr(self, "knowledge_base_name", None)
        if not kb_name:
            return None

        if not (
            hasattr(self, "graph") and self.graph and hasattr(self.graph, "context")
        ):
            return kb_name

        perm_map = self.graph.context.get("resource_permissions", {})
        node_id = getattr(self, "_id", None) or getattr(self, "vertex_id", None)
        if not node_id:
            return kb_name

        # Find our node's permission entry from the flat list
        node_perm = None
        for entry in perm_map.get("permissions", []):
            if entry.get("node_id") == node_id:
                node_perm = entry
                break
        if not node_perm:
            return kb_name

        # Find the resource entry matching our KB name
        for res in node_perm.get("resources", []):
            if res.get("resource_name") != kb_name:
                continue
            primary = res.get("primary", {})
            if primary.get("permitted"):
                return primary.get("resource_name") or kb_name
            fallback = res.get("fallback")
            if fallback and fallback.get("permitted"):
                Main.logger().debug(
                    f"Using fallback KB '{fallback.get('resource_name')}' for node {node_id}"
                )
                return fallback.get("resource_name")

        return kb_name

    @Main.telemetry_manager().workflow(name="agent_knowledge_base_retrieval")
    async def _retrieve_kb_context(self, query: str) -> str:
        """Retrieve documents from the selected KB using KnowledgeRetrievalComponent and return parsed text context."""

        workspace_id = getattr(self, "workspace_id", None)
        if not workspace_id:
            Main.logger().warning("Workspace ID not available for KB retrieval")
            return ""

        kb_name = self._get_effective_kb_name()
        if not kb_name:
            Main.logger().warning("Knowledge base name not selected")
            return ""

        try:
            kb_component = KnowledgeRetrievalComponent(**self.get_base_args())
            kb_component.set(
                workspace_id=workspace_id,
                knowledge_base_name=[kb_name],
                search_query=query,
                top_k=4,
                search_type="similarity",
            )

            kb_list = await kb_component._fetch_knowledge_bases_list_async(workspace_id)
            kb_component._kb_list_cache = kb_list

            results = await kb_component.search(query)

            if not results:
                return ""

            # Filter by score threshold
            filtered_results = []
            for result in results:
                if "score" in result:
                    if result["score"] >= kb_component.search_score_threshold:
                        filtered_results.append(result)
                else:
                    filtered_results.append(result)

            if not filtered_results:
                return ""

            # Extract text content from results
            parsed_texts = [
                result["page_content"]
                for result in filtered_results
                if result.get("page_content")
            ]

            return "\n\n".join(parsed_texts)

        except Exception as e:
            Main.logger().error(f"KB retrieval failed: {e!s}")
            return ""

    def _filter_duplicate_current_input_from_history(
        self,
        chat_history: list,
        current_input: Any,
    ) -> list:
        """Remove the latest user message from history if it matches the current input.

        This prevents duplication since the current input is passed separately to the LLM
        while also being present in the fetched chat history from the database.

        Args:
            chat_history: List of chat messages (in chronological order, oldest first)
            current_input: The current input message being sent to the LLM

        Returns:
            Filtered chat history with duplicate removed if found
        """
        if not chat_history:
            return chat_history

        current_input_text = (
            current_input.text if hasattr(current_input, "text") else str(current_input)
        )
        last_message = chat_history[-1]
        last_message_text = (
            last_message.text if hasattr(last_message, "text") else str(last_message)
        )
        last_message_sender = (
            getattr(last_message, "sender", "").lower()
            if hasattr(last_message, "sender")
            else ""
        )

        if last_message_text == current_input_text and last_message_sender in (
            "user",
            "human",
            "",
        ):
            Main.logger().debug(
                f"[Agent] Removed duplicate latest message from history | "
                f"text={current_input_text[:50]}..."
            )
            return chat_history[:-1]

        return chat_history

    def _filter_tools_by_enabled_components(self, context: dict) -> None:

        enabled_components = context.get("enabled_tool_components")
        if enabled_components is None:
            return

        Main.logger().debug(f"enabled components: {enabled_components}")
        if len(enabled_components) == 0:
            self.tools = []
            return

        original_count = len(self.tools)
        filtered_tools = [
            tool
            for tool in self.tools
            if not getattr(tool, "_component_id", None)
            or getattr(tool, "_component_id", None) in enabled_components
        ]
        self.tools = filtered_tools
        Main.logger().debug(
            f"Runtime filter: {original_count} tools -> {len(self.tools)} tools"

        if tone := comm.get(CommunicationPreferenceKey.TONE):
            if inst := TONE_INSTRUCTIONS.get(tone):
                instructions.append(inst)

        if length := comm.get(CommunicationPreferenceKey.RESPONSE_LENGTH):
            if inst := RESPONSE_LENGTH_INSTRUCTIONS.get(length):
                instructions.append(inst)

        if fmt := comm.get(CommunicationPreferenceKey.FORMAT_PREFERENCE):
            if inst := FORMAT_PREFERENCE_INSTRUCTIONS.get(fmt):
                instructions.append(inst)

        if not instructions:
            return None

        return "\nCommunication Style:\n" + "\n".join(instructions)

        collab = details.get("collaborationStyle", {})

        match collab.get(CommunicationPreferenceKey.SUGGESTION_MODE):
            case SuggestionMode.PROACTIVE_SUGGESTIONS.value:

                    "Proactively suggest improvements, optimizations, and alternative approaches."
                )
            case SuggestionMode.ANSWER_ONLY.value:
                instructions.append(

                )

        match collab.get(CommunicationPreferenceKey.DECISION_STYLE):
            case DecisionStyle.MULTIPLE_OPTIONS.value:
                instructions.append(
                    "Present multiple options with pros/cons when applicable."
                )
            case DecisionStyle.BEST_ANSWER.value:

        if collab.get(CommunicationPreferenceKey.CHALLENGE_IDEAS):
            instructions.append(
                "Challenge the user's ideas constructively and point out potential issues or gaps."
            )

        if not instructions:
            return None

        return "\nCollaboration Approach:\n" + "\n".join(instructions)

            await self._refresh_kb_options(build_config)

        # Refresh Assume Policy dropdown when policy or workspace changes
        if field_name in ("assumed_policy_id", "workspace_id"):
            await self._refresh_policy_options(build_config)

        if field_name in ("enable_structured_output", "output_schema"):

            enable_structured = (
                field_value
                if field_name == "enable_structured_output"
                else build_config.get("enable_structured_output", {}).get(
                    "value", False
                )
            )
            output_schema = (
                field_value
                if field_name == "output_schema"
                else build_config.get("output_schema", {}).get("value", [])
            )

            field_options = ["response"]
            if enable_structured and output_schema:
                if isinstance(output_schema, list):
                    field_options.extend(
                        field.get("name")
                        for field in output_schema
                        if isinstance(field, dict) and field.get("name")
                    )
                elif isinstance(output_schema, (str, dict)):
                    try:
                        schema_dict = (
                            json.loads(output_schema)
                            if isinstance(output_schema, str)
                            else output_schema
                        )
                        if (
                            isinstance(schema_dict, dict)
                            and "properties" in schema_dict
                        ):
                            field_options.extend(schema_dict["properties"].keys())
                    except (json.JSONDecodeError, AttributeError, KeyError):
                        pass
            build_config["selected_output_field"]["options"] = field_options

        # Handle guardrail toggle fields
        if field_name == "enable_input_guardrail":
            if "input_guardrails" in build_config:
                build_config["input_guardrails"]["show"] = bool(field_value)
                if field_value:
                    workspace_id = (
                        build_config.get("workspace_id", {}).get("value")
                        or self.workspace_id
                    )
                    if workspace_id:
                        options = await self._fetch_accessible_guardrail_options(
                            workspace_id
                        )
                        build_config["input_guardrails"]["options"] = options

        if field_name == "enable_output_guardrail":
            if "output_guardrails" in build_config:
                build_config["output_guardrails"]["show"] = bool(field_value)
                if field_value:
                    workspace_id = (
                        build_config.get("workspace_id", {}).get("value")
                        or self.workspace_id
                    )
                    if workspace_id:
                        options = await self._fetch_accessible_guardrail_options(
                            workspace_id
                        )
                        build_config["output_guardrails"]["options"] = options

        if field_name == "input_guardrails":
            if "input_guardrails" in build_config and build_config["input_guardrails"].get("show"):
                workspace_id = (
                    build_config.get("workspace_id", {}).get("value")
                    or self.workspace_id
                )
                if workspace_id:
                    options = await self._fetch_accessible_guardrail_options(
                        workspace_id
                    )
                    build_config["input_guardrails"]["options"] = options

        if field_name == "output_guardrails":
            if "output_guardrails" in build_config and build_config["output_guardrails"].get("show"):
                workspace_id = (
                    build_config.get("workspace_id", {}).get("value")
                    or self.workspace_id
                )
                if workspace_id:
                    options = await self._fetch_accessible_guardrail_options(
                        workspace_id
                    )
                    build_config["output_guardrails"]["options"] = options

        build_config = await self.update_llm_build_config(
            build_config, field_value, field_name, apply_input_types=True
        )
        return dotdict(
            {
                k: v.to_dict() if hasattr(v, "to_dict") else v
                for k, v in build_config.items()
            }
        )

    async def _fetch_accessible_guardrail_options(self, workspace_id: str) -> list[str]:
        """Fetch guardrail options filtered by the current user's access permissions."""
        user_id = (
            str(self.graph.user_id)
            if hasattr(self, "graph") and self.graph and hasattr(self.graph, "user_id")
            else None
        )
        orm_manager = get_orm_manager()
        try:
            async with orm_manager.with_session() as session:
                mappings = await orm_manager.get_guardrail_mappings_by_workspace_id(
                    session, workspace_id
                )
                if not mappings:
                    return []

                inhouse_mappings = [m for m in mappings if m.providerType == "INHOUSE"]
                bedrock_mappings = [m for m in mappings if m.providerType == "BEDROCK"]

                inhouse_ids = [str(m.id) for m in inhouse_mappings]
                bedrock_ids = [str(m.id) for m in bedrock_mappings]

                if user_id:
                    accessible_inhouse = (
                        await orm_manager.filter_accessible_resource_ids(
                            session,
                            user_id,
                            "INHOUSE_GUARDRAIL",
                            inhouse_ids,
                            workspace_id,
                        )
                    )
                    accessible_bedrock = (
                        await orm_manager.filter_accessible_resource_ids(
                            session,
                            user_id,
                            "BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL",
                            bedrock_ids,
                            workspace_id,
                        )
                    )
                else:
                    accessible_inhouse = set(inhouse_ids)
                    accessible_bedrock = set(bedrock_ids)

                options = []
                for m in inhouse_mappings:
                    if str(m.id) in accessible_inhouse:
                        options.append(f"{m.name}#INHOUSE")
                for m in bedrock_mappings:
                    if str(m.id) in accessible_bedrock:
                        options.append(f"{m.name}#BEDROCK")
                return options
        except Exception as e:
            Main.logger().debug(f"Failed to fetch accessible guardrail options: {e!s}")
            return []

    async def _refresh_kb_options(self, build_config: dotdict) -> None:
        """Fetch and update Knowledge Base dropdown options from database."""
        workspace_id = getattr(self, "workspace_id", None)
        if not workspace_id:
            return
        try:
            kb_list = await self._fetch_knowledge_bases_list(workspace_id)
            kb_names = [
                kb.get("knowledge_base_name")
                for kb in kb_list
                if kb.get("knowledge_base_name")
            ]
            if "knowledge_base_name" in build_config:
                build_config["knowledge_base_name"]["options"] = kb_names
                current_value = build_config["knowledge_base_name"].get("value")
                if current_value and kb_names and current_value not in kb_names:
                    build_config["knowledge_base_name"]["value"] = ""
            if "fallback_knowledge_base_name" in build_config:
                build_config["fallback_knowledge_base_name"]["options"] = [
                    ""
                ] + kb_names
        except Exception as e:
            Main.logger().error(f"Failed to fetch knowledge bases: {e!s}")

    async def _refresh_policy_options(self, build_config: dotdict) -> None:
        """Fetch and update Assume Policy dropdown options from workspace policies."""
        workspace_id = getattr(self, "workspace_id", None)
        if not workspace_id:
            return
        try:
            orm_manager = get_orm_manager()
            async with orm_manager.with_session() as session:
                policies = await orm_manager.get_policies_by_workspace_id(
                    session, workspace_id
                )
            options = [""]
            metadata = [{"label": "None (use flow settings)", "icon": "x"}]
            for p in policies:
                options.append(str(p.id))
                metadata.append({"label": p.name, "icon": "shield"})
            if "assumed_policy_id" in build_config:
                build_config["assumed_policy_id"]["options"] = options
                build_config["assumed_policy_id"]["options_metadata"] = metadata
        except Exception as e:
            Main.logger().error(f"Failed to fetch workspace policies: {e!s}")

from studio.custom import Component

class MemoryComponent(Component):
    display_name = "Message History"
    description = "Retrieves stored chat messages from Langflow tables or an external memory."
    icon = "message-square-more"
    name = "Memory"

    inputs = [
        HandleInput(
            name="memory",
            display_name="External Memory",
            input_types=["Memory"],
            info="Retrieve messages from an external memory. If empty, it will use the Langflow tables.",
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER, "Machine and User"],
            value="Machine and User",
            info="Filter by sender type.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Filter by sender name.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="n_messages",
            display_name="Number of Messages",
            value=20,
            info="Number of messages to retrieve.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="order",
            display_name="Order",
            options=["Ascending", "Descending"],
            value="Descending",
            info="Order of the messages.",
            advanced=True,
            tool_mode=True,
        ),
        MultilineInput(
            name="template",
            display_name="Template",
            info="The template to use for formatting the data. "
            "It can contain the keys {text}, {sender} or any other key in the message data.",
            value="{sender_name}: {text}",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Data", name="messages", method="retrieve_messages"),
        Output(display_name="Message", name="messages_text", method="retrieve_messages_as_text"),
        Output(display_name="DataFrame", name="dataframe", method="as_dataframe"),
    ]

    async def retrieve_messages(self) -> Data:
        sender = self.sender
        sender_name = self.sender_name
        session_id = self.session_id
        n_messages = self.n_messages
        order = "DESC" if self.order == "Descending" else "ASC"

        if sender == "Machine and User":
            sender = None

        if self.memory and not hasattr(self.memory, "aget_messages"):
            memory_name = type(self.memory).__name__
            err_msg = f"External Memory object ({memory_name}) must have 'aget_messages' method."
            raise AttributeError(err_msg)
        # Check if n_messages is None or 0
        if n_messages == 0:
            stored = []
        elif self.memory:
            # override session_id
            self.memory.session_id = session_id

            stored = await self.memory.aget_messages()
            # langchain memories are supposed to return messages in ascending order
            if order == "DESC":
                stored = stored[::-1]
            if n_messages:
                stored = stored[:n_messages]
            stored = [Message.from_lc_message(m) for m in stored]
            if sender:
                expected_type = MESSAGE_SENDER_AI if sender == MESSAGE_SENDER_AI else MESSAGE_SENDER_USER
                stored = [m for m in stored if m.type == expected_type]
        else:
            stored = await aget_messages(
                sender=sender,
                sender_name=sender_name,
                session_id=session_id,
                limit=n_messages,
                order=order,
            )
        
        Main.logger().debug(
            f"[MemoryComponent] Retrieved session history | "
            f"session_id={session_id} | order={order} | limit={n_messages} | "
            f"retrieved_count={len(stored)}"
        )
        if stored:
            preview_messages = [
                f"[{i}] {getattr(m, 'sender_name', 'unknown')}: {(getattr(m, 'text', str(m))[:50])}..."
                for i, m in enumerate(stored[:5])
            ]
            Main.logger().debug(f"[MemoryComponent] First 5 messages preview: {preview_messages}")
        
        self.status = stored
        return cast(Data, stored)

    async def retrieve_messages_as_text(self) -> Message:
        stored_text = data_to_text(self.template, await self.retrieve_messages())
        self.status = stored_text
        return Message(text=stored_text)

    async def as_dataframe(self) -> DataFrame:
        """Convert the retrieved messages into a DataFrame.

        Returns:
            DataFrame: A DataFrame containing the message data.
        """
        messages = await self.retrieve_messages()
        return DataFrame(messages)

class VoiceAgentComponent(APIRequestComponent):
    """Triggers voice agent calls via the voice backend service."""
    ERROR_MISSING_BASE_URL = "VOICE_BACKEND_SERVICE_BASE_URL environment variable is not set"
    ERROR_MISSING_SELECTION = "workspace and voice agent must be selected"

    FIELD_CALL_PARAMETERS = "call_parameters"

    FIELD_WORKSPACE_ID = "workspace_id"

    KEY_OPTIONS = "options"
    KEY_OPTIONS_METADATA = "options_metadata"
    KEY_VALUE = "value"

    _FIELD_DEFAULTS: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
        FIELD_CALL_PARAMETERS: {KEY_VALUE: []},
        FIELD_VOICE_AGENT_ID: {KEY_VALUE: "", KEY_OPTIONS: [], KEY_OPTIONS_METADATA: []},
        FIELD_WORKSPACE_ID: {KEY_VALUE: "", KEY_OPTIONS: [], KEY_OPTIONS_METADATA: []},

        DropdownInput(

    def __init__(self, *args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        self._status_output: Data | None = None

    def _init_field(self, build_config: dotdict, field_name: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Initializes a field in build_config with defaults."""
        config = build_config.setdefault(field_name, {})
        for key, default in VoiceAgentComponent._FIELD_DEFAULTS.get(field_name, {}).items():
            config.setdefault(key, default)
        return config

    async def _on_agent_change(
        self, build_config: dotdict, agent_config: dict, params_config: dict, agent_id: str
    ) -> None:

        build_config[VoiceAgentComponent.FIELD_VOICE_AGENT_ID] = agent_config

        parameters, _ = await fetch_voice_agent_call_parameters(
            agent_id=agent_id,
            authorization_token=self.ctx.get("authorization_token"),
            request=self.send_request,
            timeout=10,
            workspace_id=str(self.workspace_id) if self.workspace_id else None,
        )

    async def _on_workspace_change(
        self,

        workspace_config: dict,
        agent_config: dict,
        params_config: dict,
        selected: str | None,
        cleared: bool,
    ) -> None:
        """Handles workspace selection change."""
        user_id = str(self.user_id) if self.user_id else None
        workspaces = await fetch_user_workspaces(user_id)
        values, metadata = dropdown_values_and_metadata(workspaces)
        workspace_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_OPTIONS] = values
        workspace_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_OPTIONS_METADATA] = metadata

        current = workspace_config.get(VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_VALUE)
        workspace_id = self._pick_value(selected, str(current) if current else None, values, cleared)
        workspace_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_VALUE] = workspace_id or ""
        build_config[VoiceAgentComponent.FIELD_WORKSPACE_ID] = dict(workspace_config)

        await self._refresh_agents(agent_config, params_config, workspace_id)
        build_config[VoiceAgentComponent.FIELD_CALL_PARAMETERS] = dict(params_config)
        build_config[VoiceAgentComponent.FIELD_VOICE_AGENT_ID] = dict(agent_config)

        self, candidate: str | None, current: str | None, available: list[str], cleared: bool
    ) -> str | None:
        """Selects the best value from candidates and available options."""
        if cleared:
            return None
        for v in [candidate, current] + (available[:1] if len(available) == 1 else []):
            if v and v in available:
                return v
        return None

        """Builds call input payload from dynamic inputs with validation."""
        params = getattr(self, "call_parameters", []) or []
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for param in params:
            if not isinstance(param, dict):
                continue
            key = param.get("key")
            if not key or not isinstance(key, str):
                continue
            value = getattr(self, key, None)
            if value is None or value == "":
                continue
            payload[key] = str(value).strip()
        return payload

        self, agent_config: dict, params_config: dict, workspace_id: str | None
    ) -> None:
        """Refreshes the voice agents dropdown for the selected workspace."""
        if not workspace_id:
            agent_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_OPTIONS] = []
            agent_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_OPTIONS_METADATA] = []
            agent_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_VALUE] = ""
            params_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_VALUE] = []
            return
        agents = await fetch_workspace_voice_agents(workspace_id)
        values, metadata = dropdown_values_and_metadata(agents)
        agent_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_OPTIONS] = values
        agent_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_OPTIONS_METADATA] = metadata
        if agent_config.get(VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_VALUE) not in values:
            agent_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_VALUE] = ""
        params_config[VoiceAgentComponent.KEY_VALUE] = []

    @property
    def inputs(self) -> list:
        """Returns dynamic inputs with tool_mode for each call parameter."""
        params = getattr(self, "call_parameters", []) or []
        result = list(VoiceAgentComponent._base_inputs)
        for param in params:
            if not isinstance(param, dict):
                continue
            key = param.get("key")
            if not key:
                continue
            result.append(
                StrInput(
                    display_name=key.replace("_", " ").title(),
                    info=f"Value for {key}",
                    name=key,
                    required=True,
                    tool_mode=True,
                )
            )
        return result

    def inputs(self, value: list) -> None:

    async def get_call_status(self) -> Data:
        """Returns the status of the last voice call."""
        if self._status_output is not None:
            return self._status_output
        return Data(data={"status_code": None})

    async def trigger_voice_call(self) -> Data:
        """Triggers a voice agent call and returns the response."""
        voice_agent_id = self.voice_agent_id
        workspace_id = str(self.workspace_id) if self.workspace_id else None
        if not voice_agent_id or not workspace_id:
            raise ValueError(VoiceAgentComponent.ERROR_MISSING_SELECTION)

        base_url = _get_configuration().service_urls_configuration.voice_backend_service_base_url
        if not base_url:
            raise RuntimeError(VoiceAgentComponent.ERROR_MISSING_BASE_URL)

        auth_token = self.ctx.get("authorization_token")
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        if auth_token:
            headers["Authorization"] = auth_token

        response = await self.send_request(
            body={"call_input": self._prepare_call_input()},
            follow_redirects=True,
            headers=headers,
            include_httpx_metadata=True,
            method="POST",
            timeout=30,
            url=f"{base_url}/agents/{voice_agent_id}/internal/call",
        )

        raw = response.data if isinstance(response.data, dict) else {"result": response.data}
        status_code = raw.get("status_code") or raw.get("httpx_metadata", {}).get("status_code")

        if status_code in (HTTPStatus.FORBIDDEN, HTTPStatus.UNAUTHORIZED):
            Main.logger().error("Voice agent authorization failed (status=%s).", status_code)

        filtered_raw = {k: v for k, v in raw.items() if k != "headers"}
        self._call_response = Data(data={
            "raw": filtered_raw,
            "result": raw.get("result"),
            "status_code": status_code,
        })
        self._status_output = Data(data={"status_code": status_code})
        self.status = self._status_output
        return self._call_response

    async def update_build_config(
        self, build_config: dotdict, field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None
    ) -> dotdict:
        """Updates the build configuration when fields change."""
        agent_config = self._init_field(build_config, VoiceAgentComponent.FIELD_VOICE_AGENT_ID)
        params_config = self._init_field(build_config, VoiceAgentComponent.FIELD_CALL_PARAMETERS)
        workspace_config = self._init_field(build_config, VoiceAgentComponent.FIELD_WORKSPACE_ID)

        if field_name in (None, VoiceAgentComponent.FIELD_WORKSPACE_ID):
            await self._on_workspace_change(
                build_config, workspace_config, agent_config, params_config,
                str(field_value) if field_value else None,
                field_name == VoiceAgentComponent.FIELD_WORKSPACE_ID and not field_value,
            )
        if field_name == VoiceAgentComponent.FIELD_VOICE_AGENT_ID and field_value:
            await self._on_agent_change(build_config, agent_config, params_config, str(field_value))

        return build_config

    """Component for connecting to MCP servers and exposing tools to Agents."""

    display_name = "MCP Client"
    description = (
        "Connects to an MCP server configured for your workspace "
        "and exposes its tools to be used by an Agent. "
        "Select an MCP server from the dropdown to connect."
    )
    documentation: str = "https://docs.studio.org/components-custom-components"
    icon = "globe"
    name = "MCPClient"
    legacy = False

    # Static configuration for Bedrock AgentCore
    AWS_SERVICE: ClassVar[str] = "bedrock-agentcore"
    DEPLOYMENT_LOCATION_AGENTCORE = "AGENTCORE"
    DEPLOYMENT_LOCATION_EKS = "EKS"

    @classmethod
    def _get_default_aws_region(cls) -> str:
        """Get the default AWS region from configuration."""
        return _get_configuration().aws_configuration.aws_bedrock_region or "us-east-1"

    inputs: ClassVar[list] = [
        StrInput(
            name="workspace_id",
            display_name="Workspace ID",
            info="Workspace ID for fetching MCP servers.",
            required=True,
            show=False,

            name="mcp_server",

        TableInput(

            info="Optional configuration as key-value pairs that tools can use as parameters",
            required=False,
            table_schema=[
                {
                    "name": "key",

                    "type": "str",

                    "default": "key",
                },
                {
                    "name": "value",
                    "display_name": "Value",
                    "type": "str",
                    "description": "Configuration parameter value",
                    "default": "value",
                },
            ],

        ),
    ]

    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        """Initialize the component with cache for workspace MCPs."""
        super().__init__(**kwargs)
        self._mcp_cache: list[dict] | None = None

    async def _fetch_workspace_mcps_async(
        self, workspace_id: str,
    ) -> list[dict]:
        """Fetch enabled workspace MCPs from database."""
        async with session_scope() as session:
            workspace_mcps = await orm_manager.get_workspace_mcps_by_workspace_id(
                session, workspace_id,
            )

            mcp_list = [
                {
                    "workspace_mcp_id": workspace_mcp.id,
                    "mcp_server_name": workspace_mcp.staticMCPServer.name,
                    "deployed_url": workspace_mcp.staticMCPServer.deployedServerUrl,
                    "deployment_location": workspace_mcp.staticMCPServer.deploymentLocation,
                }
                for workspace_mcp in workspace_mcps
                if (
                    workspace_mcp.staticMCPServer
                    and workspace_mcp.staticMCPServer.deployedServerUrl
                    and workspace_mcp.staticMCPServer.overallStatus == MCPServerOverallStatus.DEPLOYED.value
                )
            ]

        return mcp_list

    async def update_build_config(
        self,
        build_config: dotdict,
        field_value: Any,
        field_name: str | None = None,
    ) -> dotdict:
        """Populate MCP server dropdown when workspace_id is available."""
        self._mcp_cache = None

        if self.workspace_id:
            mcp_list = await self._fetch_workspace_mcps_async(self.workspace_id)
            self._mcp_cache = mcp_list
            mcp_names = [mcp["mcp_server_name"] for mcp in mcp_list]
            build_config["mcp_server"]["options"] = mcp_names
            if mcp_names and not build_config["mcp_server"].get("value"):
                build_config["mcp_server"]["value"] = mcp_names[0]

        return build_config

    def _get_mcp_details_by_name(self, mcp_name: str) -> dict | None:
        """Get MCP details by name from cached list."""
        if not self._mcp_cache:
            return None

        for mcp in self._mcp_cache:
            if mcp["mcp_server_name"] == mcp_name:
                return mcp

        return None

    def _generate_server_name(self, url: str) -> str:
        """Generate a meaningful server name from URL."""
        try:
            parsed = urlparse(url)
            host = parsed.hostname or "server"
            return host.replace(".", "_").replace("-", "_")
        except ValueError:
            return "mcp_server"

    def _build_mcp_config_dict(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Convert MCP Configuration TableInput data (list of {key, value}) to a dict."""
        if not self.mcp_configuration or not isinstance(self.mcp_configuration, list):
            return {}

        return {
            item["key"]: item["value"]
            for item in self.mcp_configuration
            if isinstance(item, dict)
            and "key" in item
            and "value" in item
            and item["key"]  # Filter out empty keys
            # Allow empty values in case user wants to pass empty string
        }

    def _build_mcp_headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        """Build custom MCP headers from component context."""

        headers = {}

        authorization_token = self.ctx.get("authorization_token")
        if authorization_token:
            headers["Authorization"] = str(authorization_token)

        if self.workspace_id:
            headers["x-workspace-id"] = str(self.workspace_id)

        if self.graph:
            if self.graph.flow_id:
                headers["x-flow-id"] = str(self.graph.flow_id)
            if self.graph.session_id:
                headers["mcp-session-id"] = str(self.graph.session_id)

        if self.user_id:
            headers["x-user-id"] = str(self.user_id)

        return headers

    def _create_aws_auth(
        self, credentials: Credentials, region: str,
    ) -> AWSAuth:
        """Create AWSAuth instance for a specific region."""
        return AWSAuth(
            credentials=credentials,
            service=self.AWS_SERVICE,
            region=region,
        )

    def _create_auth_for_deployment(
        self,
        deployment_location: str,
        credentials: Credentials | None = None,
        region: str | None = None,
    ) -> httpx.Auth | None:
        """Create appropriate auth based on deployment location"""
        if deployment_location == MCPClient.DEPLOYMENT_LOCATION_AGENTCORE:
            if not credentials or not region:
                msg = "AWS credentials and region required for AGENTCORE deployment"
                raise ValueError(msg)
            return self._create_aws_auth(credentials, region)
        return None

    async def build_output(self) -> list[Tool]:
        """Connect to the selected MCP server and build tools.

        Returns:
            List of LangChain StructuredTool instances from the connected server.
        """
        try:
            if not self._mcp_cache and self.workspace_id:
                self._mcp_cache = await self._fetch_workspace_mcps_async(
                    self.workspace_id,
                )

            mcp_details = self._get_mcp_details_by_name(self.mcp_server)
            if not mcp_details:
                Main.logger().error(
                    f"MCP server '{self.mcp_server}' not found in cache",
                )
                return []

            url = mcp_details["deployed_url"]
            deployment_location = mcp_details.get("deployment_location", MCPClient.DEPLOYMENT_LOCATION_AGENTCORE)

            mcp_config_dict = self._build_mcp_config_dict()
            mcp_headers = self._build_mcp_headers()
            server_name = self._generate_server_name(url)

            # Conditional auth based on deployment location
            auth = None
            if deployment_location == MCPClient.DEPLOYMENT_LOCATION_AGENTCORE:
                session = Session()
                frozen_creds = session.get_credentials()
                if frozen_creds is None:
                    msg = "AWS credentials not found for AGENTCORE deployment"
                    raise ValueError(msg)
                frozen = frozen_creds.get_frozen_credentials()

                credentials = Credentials(
                    access_key=frozen.access_key,
                    secret_key=frozen.secret_key,
                    token=frozen.token,
                )

                region = self._get_default_aws_region()
                auth = self._create_auth_for_deployment(
                    deployment_location, credentials, region
                )
            else:
                auth = self._create_auth_for_deployment(deployment_location)
            connections = {
                server_name: {
                    "url": url,
                    "transport": "streamable_http",
                    "auth": auth,
                    "headers": mcp_headers,
                },
            }

            client = MultiServerMCPClient(connections=connections)
            all_tools: list[BaseTool] = await client.get_tools()
            for tool in all_tools:
                tool.handle_tool_error = True
            unique_tools = list(
                {tool.name: tool for tool in all_tools}.values(),
            )

            if len(unique_tools) < len(all_tools):
                duplicate_count = len(all_tools) - len(unique_tools)
                Main.logger().warning(
                    f"Found {duplicate_count} duplicate tool names, "
                    "keeping first occurrences",
                )

            # Attach MCP configuration and server name to each tool's metadata
            if self.mcp_configuration or self.mcp_server:
                for tool in unique_tools:
                    if not hasattr(tool, 'metadata') or tool.metadata is None:
                        tool.metadata = {}

                    # Attach MCP server name
                    if self.mcp_server:
                        tool.metadata['mcp_server_name'] = self.mcp_server

                    # Attach MCP configuration (only if non-empty)
                    if mcp_config_dict:
                        tool.metadata['mcp_configuration'] = mcp_config_dict

                Main.logger().debug(
                    f"Attached MCP metadata to {len(unique_tools)} tools: "
                    f"server='{self.mcp_server}', config={mcp_config_dict}"
                )

            always_ask = bool(getattr(self, ALWAYS_ASK_INPUT_NAME, False))
            unique_tools = McpToolHitlWrapper(
                self.graph,
                self._id,
                self.mcp_server or "",
                always_ask,
            ).apply(unique_tools)
            if always_ask:
                Main.logger().debug(
                    "MCP HITL review enabled for %d tools | mcp_server=%s | vertex_id=%s",
                    len(unique_tools),
                    self.mcp_server,
                    self._id,
                )

            Main.logger().info(
                f"Successfully connected to MCP server '{self.mcp_server}' "
                f"and loaded {len(unique_tools)} unique tools",
            )
            return unique_tools

        except Exception as e:
            Main.logger().error(f"Error connecting to MCP server: {e}")
            raise
